threepl.simulator

Class SimDetails

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SimDetails
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    SimPlotDetails, SimTraceDetails

    public abstract class SimDetails
extends java.lang.Object
    This is a base class for SimTraceDetails and SimPlotDetails. It contains a reference to the SimLogger associated with the trace or plot (SimLogger handles data storage and retrieval); also contains the enable expression for the trace or plot, and the associated enabled flag; also the array of trace or plot expressions. Note that the enable related fields and the expression array are not used for a pre-existing trace or plot (ie one which already existed and is being reviewed, not currently created).
